2.30 pm                 An hour long pupil-led tour of the school has been arranged for 2.30 pm starting (promptly) from Chums (Pupil Social Centre), King’s, School Canterbury.

Traveling to Canterbury by Car

Canterbury Accommodation 
There are numerous places to stay in Canterbury.  Please use the link ‘Canterbury Accommodation’ above to book your accommodation (if required).

We very much look forward to welcoming you to King’s and hope you have an informative and enjoyable visit.
